title: Sequoia Winter Weekend
summary: Christmas in the Giant Forest with a 2-year-old: snow play at Wolverton, the General Sherman Tree, easy big-tree walks, two nights at Wuksachi Lodge. Relaxed pace with a midday nap every day.

travelers.notes: Toddler naps ~1–3pm; car seat; motion sickness possible on Generals Highway hairpins.

theme.mood: Giant sequoias in fresh snow, red bark, quiet winter light

places.name: Sequoia Coffee Co.
places.notes: Coffee + breakfast before the climb. Fallback: Sequoia Coffee & Kitchen next door.

places.name: The River View Grill and Bar
places.notes: Riverside patio; kid-friendly lunch on the way out.

places.name: Shell — Three Rivers (last gas)
places.notes: No gas or EV charging inside the park. Fill up here. Chevron 0.3 mi north is the backup.

places.name: Foothills Visitor Center
places.address: Generals Hwy, Three Rivers, CA 93271 (just past Ash Mountain entrance)
places.notes: Restrooms, maps, ask rangers about chain controls and Wolverton status.

places.name: Giant Forest Museum
places.notes: Small, warm, stroller-friendly. Holiday shuttle stop when running.

places.name: Big Trees Trail (Round Meadow)
places.notes: 1.3 mi loop, paved and flat in summer; snow-covered in winter → bring the toddler carrier or snowshoes. Trail starts across the road from the museum.

places.name: Lodgepole Market
places.address: 63204 Lodgepole Rd, Sequoia National Park, CA 93262
places.notes: Snacks, basic groceries, sleds when open. Don't count on it on Dec 25.

places.name: Lodgepole Visitor Center
places.hours: Often closed or limited in winter — verify

places.name: Wuksachi Lodge
places.address: 64740 Wuksachi Way, Sequoia National Park, CA 93262
places.notes: Confirmation #REPLACE-ME. 2 nights (Dec 24–26). Parking at the lodge; rooms are in buildings a short walk from the main lodge — bring the bags in one trip with the stroller. Snowshoe and pole rentals here when the lodge is open.

places.name: The Peaks Restaurant (Wuksachi)
places.notes: Only sit-down restaurant open in the Giant Forest area in winter. Reserve Christmas Eve and Christmas dinner early. High chairs available (verify).

places.name: Wolverton Snowplay Area
places.notes: 7,250 ft. The park's only designated sledding area. After storms the road can take hours to open (plows clear Generals Hwy first). Slide feet-first, stay away from the road and parking lot.

places.name: General Sherman Tree — parking
places.notes: Main lot off Wolverton Rd closes once snow accumulates. Then use the accessible parking area on Generals Hwy (open to all in winter) — follow signs.

places.name: General Sherman Tree
places.notes: Largest tree on Earth by volume. From the main lot it's 0.5 mi each way with stairs and ~200 ft back up — carrier, not stroller. From the winter accessible lot it's a short, flatter walk.

places.name: Hospital Rock
places.notes: Pictographs and bedrock mortars of the Monache people, 2 minutes from the road. Usually below the snow line — good leg-stretch on the way down.

places.name: Kaweah Health Medical Center (ER)
places.address: 400 W Mineral King Ave, Visalia, CA 93291
places.notes: Nearest full hospital — about 1.5–2 hours from Wuksachi in winter.

routes.name: Three Rivers → Foothills Visitor Center
routes.notes: CA-198 becomes Generals Hwy at the Ash Mountain entrance. Holiday entrance lines can be long.

routes.name: Foothills → Giant Forest (Generals Highway)
routes.notes: Climbs ~5,000 ft with many hairpins (not recommended for vehicles > 22 ft between Hospital Rock and Wolverton). Chains may be required at any time — carry them even with AWD/4WD. Use pullouts if the toddler gets carsick.

routes.name: Museum → Big Trees Trail
routes.notes: Cross the Generals Highway carefully; trail may be snow-covered.

routes.name: Giant Forest → Wuksachi Lodge
routes.notes: Passes the Sherman Tree and Lodgepole turnoffs. Icy in the shade after 3pm.

routes.name: Wuksachi → Wolverton Snowplay
routes.notes: Wolverton Rd may open late after storms. Ask at the lodge desk.

routes.name: Wuksachi → General Sherman parking
routes.notes: If the main lot is closed for snow, use the accessible lot on Generals Hwy.

routes.name: Sherman Tree Trail (main lot)
routes.notes: Paved but steep with steps; icy in winter — traction devices (microspikes) help.

routes.name: Wuksachi → Hospital Rock → Three Rivers
routes.notes: Allow extra time behind slow traffic; use low gear on the descent to save brakes.

routes.name: Three Rivers → Kaweah Health (Visalia)
routes.notes: CA-198 west. Cell service returns around Three Rivers.

items.title: Breakfast & coffee
items.notes: Use the restroom here — next real one is the visitor center.

items.title: Fill up — last gas
items.notes: Check chains are in the car. Call road line (559) 565-3341 while you still have signal.

items.title: Foothills Visitor Center
items.notes: Pay entry ($35/vehicle, 7 days) or show a pass. Ask about chain controls and Wolverton.

items.title: Climb Generals Highway to Giant Forest
items.notes: ~50 min + buffer for slow traffic and a carsick stop.

items.title: Picnic lunch in the car / museum
items.notes: Bring lunch from Three Rivers — no food for sale here in winter.

items.title: Big Trees Trail (as far as the toddler likes)
items.notes: Carrier on; turn around whenever. Nap may start in the carrier.

items.title: Lodgepole Market supplies (if open)
items.notes: Snacks, milk, maybe a sled. If closed, the lodge gift shop sells snowplay gear.

items.title: Christmas Eve dinner — The Peaks
items.notes: Reservation recommended. Early seating suits toddler bedtime.

items.title: Drive to Wolverton
items.notes: Check at the front desk whether Wolverton Rd is plowed.

items.title: Sledding & snow play
items.notes: Snow suit, waterproof mittens, sunscreen (7,250 ft). Warm-up breaks in the car every ~30 min. Watch for hypothermia: shivering, fussiness, clumsy hands.

items.title: Drive to the General Sherman Tree
General Sherman Tree
items.notes: Late-afternoon light in the sequoias. Back to the car before dusk (~4:50pm).

items.title: One more snow session or Lodgepole walk
items.notes: Optional — skip if roads are icy or a storm is due; the descent matters more.

items.title: Drive down Generals Highway
items.notes: ~1h25 without stops. Low gear on the descent.

emergency.notes: There is little or no cell service in most of the park; Wi-Fi and phones at Wuksachi Lodge and Lodgepole work. 911 texts sometimes get through where calls fail. The nearest hospital is in Visalia, 1.5–2 h from the lodge in winter — rangers can coordinate an ambulance or helicopter.

offline_notes: Download this trip in Waypack (with map) and a Google Maps offline area covering Visalia → Lodgepole before leaving home.
